# MCX feature catalogue

*Generated by `python -m research.brain.mcx.features catalog` from `research/brain/mcx/features.py`. Do not edit by hand.*

56 features, signature `4d6b30979116` (MCX cube v1). One row per MCX session minute. Every feature at minute t uses only cube rows with ts <= t, and daily bars of earlier days (checked by `research/brain/tests/test_mcx_brain.py` and `python -m research.brain.mcx.guard`). Prices are minute closes; windows never cross a contract segment. Labels are not features (`labels.py`).

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gap_open` | 1 | 1d | minutes.close | today's first close vs the previous session's last close (same contract segment), % |
| `ret_15m` | 1 | 15m | minutes.close | log return over the last 15 minutes, % |
| `ret_240m` | 1 | 240m | minutes.close | log return over the last 240 minutes, % |
| `ret_30m` | 1 | 30m | minutes.close | log return over the last 30 minutes, % |
| `ret_5m` | 1 | 5m | minutes.close | log return over the last 5 minutes, % |
| `ret_60m` | 1 | 60m | minutes.close | log return over the last 60 minutes, % |
| `ret_day` | 1 | day | minutes.close | log return since the session's first close, % |
